productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Follow the inspiring journeys of England stars Bellingham, Palmer, Saka, Foden and Rice as they rise from young football dreamers to international heroes. Ultimate Football Heroes: England Men's Team Collection celebrates five of England's brightest football stars. From academy prospects to international heroes, discover the inspiring stories behind the players leading England on the world stage today. Ultimate Football Heroes is a series of biographies telling the life stories of the biggest and best footballers in the world, following their incredible journeys from childhood fans to global superstars. Told in a fast-paced, action-packed style, with immersive sound effects that transport listeners straight onto the pitch, these audiobooks are perfect for football fans of all ages to enjoy together. This collection includes: Ultimate Football Heroes: BellinghamUltimate Football Heroes: PalmerUltimate Football Heroes: SakaUltimate Football Heroes: FodenUltimate Football Heroes: Rice Discover the determination, talent and unforgettable moments that helped these England stars rise to the top of the game and represent their country on football's biggest stages. Tracks included: A Dream World Cup Debut Hagley's Next Football Hero? Hours (& Hours) of Football Fun Becoming A Blue The Brilliant Bellingham Brothers Birmingham's Next Big Thing If You're Good Enough, You're Good Enough First Steps in the First Team Syrenka Cup Success Birmingham Breakthrough Saying Goodbye to Birmingham Early Days at Dortmund England Excitement Challenging in the Champions League Trophy Time! A Euro 2020 Experience to Remember Better and Better Jude Vs Jamal Another Season, Another Step Forward England's World Cup Wonder Kid World Cup Woe Bellingham Honours Greatest Moments Play Like Your Heroes Credits
